title: Neymar's Last Game Ended in Tears — Brazil's Earliest Exit Since 1990

scenes.voiceover: Brazil's World Cup dream just died — and their biggest star just played his very last game for the national team.
scenes.mainText: BRAZIL'S WORLD CUP DREAM JUST DIED
scenes.backgroundPrompt: A lone footballer walking off a dark stadium pitch under fading floodlights, back turned to camera, somber and final, cinematic painterly illustration, no text, no watermark

scenes.voiceover: Brazil came into this tournament as five-time champions and heavy favorites — a draw with Morocco, then routs of Haiti and Scotland, three goals each.
scenes.mainText: BRAZIL LOOKED UNSTOPPABLE IN THE GROUP STAGE
scenes.backgroundPrompt: A football team celebrating together on the pitch after a win, yellow and green kits, confident and joyful, cinematic painterly illustration, no text, no watermark

scenes.voiceover: Round of 32: Brazil 2, Japan 1. Still rolling.
Then, the Round of 16: Brazil 1, Norway 2.
Erling Haaland scored both Norway goals — the 79th minute, then the 90th-minute winner.
scenes.mainText: HAALAND SCORED TWICE — INCLUDING THE 90TH MINUTE WINNER
scenes.backgroundPrompt: A footballer in a white and blue kit sprinting in wild celebration after scoring a late winning goal, stadium floodlights, roaring crowd, cinematic painterly illustration, no text, no watermark

scenes.voiceover: Neymar pulled one back with a stoppage-time penalty, in the tenth minute of added time — too little, too late. Then, right after the final whistle, he announced his international retirement.
scenes.mainText: NEYMAR'S PENALTY CAME TOO LATE — THEN HE RETIRED
scenes.backgroundPrompt: A lone footballer in a yellow kit standing on the pitch looking down, head bowed, stadium lights dimming around him, quiet emotional moment after a loss, cinematic painterly illustration, no text, no watermark

scenes.voiceover: This is Brazil's earliest World Cup exit since 1990 — thirty-six years ago.
scenes.mainText: BRAZIL'S EARLIEST WORLD CUP EXIT SINCE 1990

scenes.voiceover: That brace also pulled Haaland level with Messi and Mbappé at the top of the Golden Boot race — seven goals each.
scenes.mainText: HAALAND'S BRACE PULLED HIM LEVEL FOR THE GOLDEN BOOT

scenes.voiceover: On the same day, England also advanced — beating Mexico 3-2 in the Round of 16.
Which sets up the Quarterfinals: Norway versus England, July 11th.
scenes.mainText: NORWAY NOW FACES ENGLAND — QUARTERFINALS, JULY 11
